observations.statement: Native inventory row code already renders a condition ratio. Verify an actual display gap before adding a second indicator.
Native selection/transfer-related inventory code checks favorite state. This observation does not prove server protection for a new operation.
The native crafting UI already has search/filter widgets; a new adapter must demonstrate missing behavior rather than duplicate the whole panel.
Native filtering declares an output-item filter capability. Runtime availability and exact input coverage still need comparison.
Building has a separate native recipe-panel path. Crafting-hook correctness does not prove construction correctness.
Native health presentation gates some wound details by doctor skill or cheat state. Preserve the ordinary player visibility path.
A native panel reads the current pain moodle; nearby numeric health/stat displays also have privilege gates and cannot be reused as unrestricted HUD data.
Native eating has a completion phase. New assistance must delegate to the validated action lifecycle rather than mutate nutrition from a background UI callback.
A native magazine loading action is present; inspect its exact constructor, validity and complete path before extending queues.
Native keybinding declarations exist; a shortcut adapter still needs exact registration and focus/controller verification.
A native inventory context path accesses recorded-media data; knowledge checks must be audited separately.
